title: fix(fields): resolve lookup/user/status/text renderer display bugs — raw IDs, primitive values, registry gaps, null consistency
body:
Lookup (`customer`, `account`) and user fields were rendering raw integer IDs instead of resolved labels across all grid views. Five distinct defects in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`: ## Defects fixed - **`LookupCellRenderer` — primitive ID not resolved** (root cause of screenshot) Only destructured `value`, never touched `field`. When the API returns `customer: 2` (unexpanded FK), fell through to `String(value)`. Now reads `field.options` and resolves via `String(opt.value) === String(val)`, covering both single primitives and arrays of IDs. ```tsx // Before: value=2 → "2" // After: value=2, field.options=[{value:2, label:'Acme'}] → "Acme" export function LookupCellRenderer({ value, field }: CellRendererProps) { const options = (field as { options?: Array<{ value: unknown; label: string }> }).options || []; const resolveLabel = (val: unknown) => options.find(o => String(o.value) === String(val))?.label ?? String(val); // ... } ``` - **`UserCellRenderer` — silent fallback for primitive IDs** Accessing `.name` on a number is `undefined`; fell through to generic `"User"` avatar. Now returns a plain `` for any non-object value. Array items that are primitives are also guarded. - **`getCellRenderer` standardMap — wrong fallback for `lookup`/`master_detail`** Both were mapped to `SelectCellRenderer` instead of `LookupCellRenderer`. Dead code (shadowed by `fieldRegistry`), but semantically wrong. - **`fieldRegistry` — missing explicit registrations** `status`, `user`, and `owner` were never pre-registered; only reachable via the `standardMap` fallback. Now explicitly registered alongside `lookup`/`master_detail`/`select`. - **`TextCellRenderer` — falsy null guard swallowed numeric zero** Used `value || '-'` which incorrectly rendered `'-'` for a value of `0`. Updated to `(value != null && value !== '') ? String(value) : '-'` for consistent null-only suppression, matching the pattern used by all other renderers. ## Tests 36 new unit tests in `cell-renderers.test.tsx` covering: registry identity assertions for all 5 types; `TextCellRenderer` with null, undefined, empty string, numeric zero (`0` renders `"0"` not `"-"`), and boolean false; `LookupCellRenderer` with null, empty string, primitive number/string ID, unresolved primitive, object (`name`/`label`/`_id` fallback chain), array of objects, array of primitive IDs resolved via options; `UserCellRenderer` with null, primitive number, primitive string, object with name/username, array of user objects.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 字段类型显示问题全面排查与修复 > ### 问题描述 > > 在列表、详情、报表等各类视图中，部分字段类型的数据显示存在异常，典型表现如 lookup/关联型字段仅显示 ID 而未显示名称；select 字段未正确映射 label；部分类型在值为 null/空时显示不一致。详见反馈截图： > > > > ### 排查目标 > 1. **全面梳理所有支持的字段类型**，包括但不限于： > - text, textarea > - number, currency, percent > - date, datetime, time > - lookup, master_detail > - select, status > - boolean > - user, owner > - file, image > - object, vector, grid、formula > - 其它���定义/派生类�� > 2. **验证每种字段类型在主流显示位置的表现**（如 ObjectGrid、Detail、AgGrid、ReportViewer 等），包括： > - 空值/无值/null 时显示 > - 关联型字段是否未映射 ID > - select/lookup/options 能否正确显示 label > - 数值型/百分比/货币格式是否合理 > - user/owner 等是否能显示头像/姓名等 > - 其它自定义渲染逻辑是否有缺陷 > 3. **梳理现有 cell renderer 的 fallback 逻辑与 options 解析（如 lookup）**，全面修复所有已知和潜在的字段展示 bug。 > > ### 预期修复方向 > - 优化 Lookup/Select 等字段渲染器，确保即便 value 为原始 ID 也能通过 options 查找 label。 > - 明确各字段类型的空值展示策略，风格统一。 > - 核查注册表与 fallback，确保所有类型优先匹配专用 renderer。 > - 检查和完善数据处理层，增补 API 返回的数据格式及必要的 populate/expand。 > - 为每个主流字段类型补充分支 UT，测试各种显示场景。 > > ### 备注 > - 建议修复同时补充 snapshot/单元测试。 > - **修复完成后必须运行相应 test，并且检查其它潜在相关问题，任务完成后更新 roadmap。** > > --- > 如需细分子任务，可按字段类型或显示视图再做拆分。 > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
